rules.desc: sort the numbers in descending order and take the first five
pick the five numbers closest to 100
pick the five numbers farthest from the mean of the list
rules.body:
m = sum(lst)/len(lst)
    s = sorted(lst, key=lambda x: -abs(x - m))[:5]

rules.desc: sort by last digit in descending order and take the first five
pick the five numbers closest to the mean of the list
rules.body:
m = sum(lst)/len(lst)
    s = sorted(lst, key=lambda x: abs(x - m))[:5]

rules.desc: sort the numbers in ascending order and take the first five
pick numbers above 50, then take the five largest of those
rules.body:
f = [x for x in lst if x > 50]
    s = sorted(f, reverse=True)[:5] if len(f) >= 5 else sorted(lst, reverse=True)[:5]

rules.desc: sort by the number of divisors of each number, descending
rules.body: s = sorted(lst, key=lambda x: -sum(1 for i in range(1, int(abs(x)) + 1) if abs(x) % i == 0))[:5]
